summary: Applicant data can cross agency boundaries through the screening detail endpoint and cached tenant configuration.
Income annualization and state poverty-level adjustments can misstate eligibility for borderline households.
A timed-out vendor verification is retried under a new idempotency key, creating duplicate vendor records.
The shipping assistant prompt follows injected instructions and states unsupported benefit amounts.
The screener has unlabeled inputs, low-contrast helper text, and an unnamed chat control.
Full Social Security numbers are returned in application responses and written into timeline events.
